paths_reviewed.review_notes: The test fixes REM-051 naming by explicitly creating one it() per FK instead of unresolved it.each placeholders. Thirty-seven “existence” cases query information_schema.table_constraints using table_name and a constraint-name LIKE on column; refTable is interpolated only in the test title, so the query does not prove the exact referenced table/column or exact constraint column. Five enforcement cases insert invalid references in a transaction rolled back in finally; the helper accepts any caught error whose message contains “foreign key” instead of checking PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 23503. Fixtures use generated UUIDs and synthetic example.test identity. The code connects through getTestPool; setup behavior depends on explicit integration-test environment. The REM-051 artifact reports a historical 42/42 PASS against an ephemeral database, but no DB suite was rerun for this review.

verification.summary: Documentation links/governance and current Triple-A snapshot validators passed after the static FK source review. No database test was run.
verification.environment: Linux local workspace; Node.js v22.23.2; pnpm 10.33.0.

findings_and_limits.observation: The loop creates concrete table/column/reference names in individual test descriptions, removing the prior undefined-placeholder diagnostic defect recorded by REM-051.

The 37-case metadata query filters table_name and a wildcard constraint_name containing column; it does not assert key_column_usage.column_name or referenced_table_name/referenced_column_name. refTable is used only in the title. These tests can pass without proving the stated FK target.
The five negative cases only assert that a caught error message contains “foreign key”; SQLSTATE 23503 is not asserted, and no positive insert confirms the expected valid relation.

The test uses getTestPool and transaction/rollback fixtures; integration setup can create/migrate/drop a database based on environment. REM-051 records 42/42 against a named ephemeral DB on 22/09, but this review did not rerun setup or tests to avoid crossing a PostgreSQL boundary.
Test records use random UUIDs, fixed synthetic labels and an example.test address; no real patient/user or provider data is supplied.

candidate_actions: Count this original path reviewed for inventory/source-content scope; do not infer full FK schema correctness from its current assertions.
Retain the REM-051 42/42 claim as historical ephemeral-run evidence only; any fresh integration run must use an explicitly disposable test database and cleanup boundary.
